title: 多哈地鐵
summary: 以多哈地鐵為背景，建立高溫潮濕環境與活動散場旅客同時出現的教學案例。學徒從空調、濾材與供電負載追蹤到月台隊列、車門和自動行車，區分日常平均需求與短時大量到達所需的控制措施。
summaryEn: Use Doha Metro to construct a teaching case combining a hot humid environment with a large post-event passenger release. Trace cooling, filters and power demand into platform queues, doors and automated movement. Distinguish normal mean demand from short-duration batch arrivals, and require measurable control actions instead of treating advertised frequency as evidence that every crowd can be absorbed immediately.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升與濾網壓差與通風功率
stages.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat & Filter pressure drop and fan power
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風散熱與設備溫升」與「濾網壓差與通風功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" and "Filter pressure drop and fan power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風散熱與設備溫升」如何影響多哈地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Doha Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。設備房還存在短路循環和局部熱點，平均送排風溫差不能保證所有電子模組都在同樣環境中。 顯熱負載決定溫度改變需求，但高濕環境還有潛熱除濕與新風處理。冷卻量和耗電量也不同，兩者需要效率或性能係數連結，不能把熱量數字當作電表讀值。 把顯熱模型與尚未計入的潛熱除濕需求明確分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風散熱與設備溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. Insufficient flow raises exhaust temperature. Equipment rooms also contain recirculation and hot spots, so an average supply-to-exhaust difference does not guarantee identical conditions around every electronic module. Sensible load describes temperature-related demand, while humidity introduces latent dehumidification and outdoor-air treatment. Cooling delivered and electricity consumed are different quantities, connected through efficiency or a performance coefficient rather than treated as identical meter readings. Separate the sensible-heat model explicitly from latent dehumidification demand not yet included. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通風散熱與設備溫升」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升
knowledge.text: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。設備房還存在短路循環和局部熱點，平均送排風溫差不能保證所有電子模組都在同樣環境中。
knowledge.textEn: Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. Insufficient flow raises exhaust temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風散熱與設備溫升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" is correct?
options: 風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱
流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。
濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好
optionsEn: Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet.
Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise.
Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition.
quiz.explanation: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風散熱與設備溫升」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K。敏感度：heat 單獨增加百分之十至 20592 W，其餘固定，結果為 14.22886 K。模型邊界：穩態顯熱且混合均勻；不含潛熱、輻射與空調循環效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K. Sensitivity: heat, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 20592 W, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.22886 K. Model boundary: Steady sensible heat and uniform mixing; latent heat, radiation and refrigeration-cycle efficiency are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K。敏感度：heat 單獨增加百分之十至 20592 W，其餘固定，結果為 14.22886 K。模型邊界：穩態顯熱且混合均勻；不含潛熱、輻射與空調循環效率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K. Sensitivity: heat, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 20592 W, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.22886 K. Model boundary: Steady sensible heat and uniform mixing; latent heat, radiation and refrigeration-cycle efficiency are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風散熱與設備溫升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat", which statement holds?
options: 兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間
停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s。
optionsEn: Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time.
A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通風散熱與設備溫升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。 同步量測進出風溫度、流量和耗電，另記濕度與新風比例，確認顯熱邊界一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment. Measure inlet and outlet air temperature, airflow and electricity together, separately recording humidity and outdoor-air fraction to confirm consistent sensible boundaries. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較降低風量與增加設備負載兩種情況，建立溫升敏感度表，再選出能辨別旁通流和真正熱負荷增加的測點。 再以本單元 heat 的對照值重算 air_rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare reduced flow with increased equipment load, tabulate temperature sensitivity, and choose sensors distinguishing bypass flow from a genuine load increase. Also recalculate air_rise for the alternative heat value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：濾網堵塞或風道短路會降低有效冷卻，即使總風機轉速正常；散熱器積塵也可能提高晶片溫度而房間平均值不變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A blocked filter or airflow bypass reduces effective cooling despite normal fan speed; dusty heat sinks can raise chip temperature without changing the room average. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。 同步量測進出風溫度、流量和耗電，另記濕度與新風比例，確認顯熱邊界一致。
knowledge.textEn: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment. Measure inlet and outlet air temperature, airflow and electricity together, separately recording humidity and outdoor-air fraction to confirm consistent sensible boundaries.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較降低風量與增加設備負載兩種情況，建立溫升敏感度表，再選出能辨別旁通流和真正熱負荷增加的測點。 再以本單元 heat 的對照值重算 air_rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare reduced flow with increased equipment load, tabulate temperature sensitivity, and choose sensors distinguishing bypass flow from a genuine load increase. Also recalculate air_rise for the alternative heat value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風散熱與設備溫升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat"?
options: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
支承越柔軟所有頻率的振動就一定越小
optionsEn: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Softer supports necessarily reduce vibration at every frequency.
quiz.explanation: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通風散熱與設備溫升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 濾網堵塞或風道短路會降低有效冷卻，即使總風機轉速正常；散熱器積塵也可能提高晶片溫度而房間平均值不變。 濕度升高仍可能需要更多冷量，即使乾球溫度沒有改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blocked filter or airflow bypass reduces effective cooling despite normal fan speed; dusty heat sinks can raise chip temperature without changing the room average. Rising humidity can require more cooling even if the dry-bulb temperature has not changed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把顯熱模型與尚未計入的潛熱除濕需求明確分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate the sensible-heat model explicitly from latent dehumidification demand not yet included.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 濾網堵塞或風道短路會降低有效冷卻，即使總風機轉速正常；散熱器積塵也可能提高晶片溫度而房間平均值不變。 濕度升高仍可能需要更多冷量，即使乾球溫度沒有改變。
knowledge.textEn: A blocked filter or airflow bypass reduces effective cooling despite normal fan speed; dusty heat sinks can raise chip temperature without changing the room average. Rising humidity can require more cooling even if the dry-bulb temperature has not changed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風散熱與設備溫升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
濾網堵塞或風道短路會降低有效冷卻，即使總風機轉速正常；散熱器積塵也可能提高晶片溫度而房間平均值不變。
濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A blocked filter or airflow bypass reduces effective cooling despite normal fan speed.
Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition.
quiz.explanation: 濾網堵塞或風道短路會降低有效冷卻，即使總風機轉速正常；散熱器積塵也可能提高晶片溫度而房間平均值不變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A blocked filter or airflow bypass reduces effective cooling despite normal fan speed; dusty heat sinks can raise chip temperature without changing the room average. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter pressure drop and fan power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濾網壓差與通風功率」如何影響多哈地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter pressure drop and fan power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Doha Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 風機必須克服風道與濾網壓差才能輸送空氣，輸入功率近似為壓差乘體積流率再除效率。積塵提高阻力但工作點會沿風機曲線改變，因此固定風量假設只是一種受控比較。 風機功率等於壓力差乘體積流率再除以宣告效率，壓力與流量必須使用同一工作點。積塵使阻力和風機工作點共同改變，固定流量算例不能預測未控制風量時的耗電。 在高濕進氣情境下檢查濾材壓差與風量的共同變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾網壓差與通風功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fan must overcome duct and filter pressure losses to move air. Input power is approximately pressure rise times volume flow divided by efficiency. Dust raises resistance but shifts the operating point on the fan curve, so fixed flow is only a controlled comparison. Fan power equals pressure difference times volume flow divided by the declared efficiency. Pressure and flow must refer to one operating point. Dust changes resistance and the fan operating point together, so a fixed-flow example cannot predict consumption without airflow control. Examine joint changes in filter pressure drop and airflow under humid intake conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter pressure drop and fan power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=364 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1516.667 W。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=364 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1; calculation: fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1516.667 W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濾網壓差與通風功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filter pressure drop and fan power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濾網壓差與通風功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter pressure drop and fan power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=364 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1516.667 W。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 400.4 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 1668.333 W。模型邊界：固定風量與總效率；不包含風機曲線移動和馬達熱限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=364 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1; calculation: fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1516.667 W. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 400.4 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1668.333 W. Model boundary: Fixed flow and overall efficiency; fan-curve shifts and motor thermal limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=364 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1516.667 W。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 400.4 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 1668.333 W。模型邊界：固定風量與總效率；不包含風機曲線移動和馬達熱限制。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=364 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1; calculation: fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1516.667 W. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 400.4 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1668.333 W. Model boundary: Fixed flow and overall efficiency; fan-curve shifts and motor thermal limits are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter pressure drop and fan power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濾網壓差與通風功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter pressure drop and fan power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。 校正取壓點與風量計，同步量測電功率，核對效率是否包含馬達與驅動器損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing. Calibrate pressure taps and airflow measurement, record electric power simultaneously, and check whether efficiency includes motor and drive losses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對堵塞與旁路兩個情境列出壓差、風量和粒子濃度的預期方向，設計三項量測共同判斷而非只靠單一數字。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 fan_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Predict pressure drop, airflow and particle concentration for clogging and bypass scenarios, then design a three-measurement diagnosis instead of relying on one number. Also recalculate fan_power for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。 校正取壓點與風量計，同步量測電功率，核對效率是否包含馬達與驅動器損失。
knowledge.textEn: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing. Calibrate pressure taps and airflow measurement, record electric power simultaneously, and check whether efficiency includes motor and drive losses.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對堵塞與旁路兩個情境列出壓差、風量和粒子濃度的預期方向，設計三項量測共同判斷而非只靠單一數字。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 fan_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Predict pressure drop, airflow and particle concentration for clogging and bypass scenarios, then design a three-measurement diagnosis instead of relying on one number. Also recalculate fan_power for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濾網壓差與通風功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Filter pressure drop and fan power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 壓差很低也可能是旁通，須核對濾材密封及實際風量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. Very low pressure drop can indicate bypass; check filter sealing and actual airflow. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在高濕進氣情境下檢查濾材壓差與風量的共同變化。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 壓差很低也可能是旁通，須核對濾材密封及實際風量。
